title: Treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="34" ry="6" fill="#2a1a4a"/>

  <!-- chest body -->
  <rect x="18" y="52" width="64" height="30" rx="6" fill="#8a4b1e"/>
  <!-- chest body lighter front panel -->
  <rect x="22" y="58" width="56" height="20" rx="4" fill="#b86b2c"/>
  <!-- wood plank lines -->
  <rect x="22" y="64" width="56" height="2" fill="#9a5522"/>
  <rect x="22" y="71" width="56" height="2" fill="#9a5522"/>

  <!-- lid (open, tilted back) -->
  <path d="M18 52 Q18 34 50 30 Q82 34 82 52 Z" fill="#a05a24"/>
  <!-- lid inner glow -->
  <path d="M25 50 Q25 38 50 35 Q75 38 75 50 Z" fill="#7a3f14"/>

  <!-- treasure glow inside -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="20" ry="6" fill="#ffd34d"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="49" rx="14" ry="4" fill="#fff2a8"/>

  <!-- gold coins spilling -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="52" r="5" fill="#ffcf33"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="52" r="3" fill="#fff09a"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="53" r="5" fill="#ffd94a"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="53" r="3" fill="#fff4b0"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="52" r="5" fill="#ffcf33"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="52" r="3" fill="#fff09a"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="57" r="4" fill="#ffd94a"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="57" r="2.5" fill="#fff4b0"/>

  <!-- gem -->
  <path d="M56 45 L60 49 L56 53 L52 49 Z" fill="#ff5ea8"/>
  <path d="M56 47 L58 49 L56 51 L54 49 Z" fill="#ffb3d6"/>

  <!-- corner metal bands -->
  <rect x="18" y="52" width="6" height="30" rx="3" fill="#ffb84d"/>
  <rect x="76" y="52" width="6" height="30" rx="3" fill="#ffb84d"/>
  <circle cx="21" cy="67" r="2.5" fill="#ffe08a"/>
  <circle cx="79" cy="67" r="2.5" fill="#ffe08a"/>

  <!-- latch -->
  <rect x="45" y="56" width="10" height="10" rx="3" fill="#ffb84d"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="61" r="2.5" fill="#ffe08a"/>
</svg>
